options.content:
Painel publico em modo somente leitura.
A troca entre REAL e DRY RUN fica disponivel apenas na interface local do exporter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH bucketed AS (
  SELECT
    to_timestamp($__unixEpochGroup(timestamp, $__interval)) AS "time",
    COALESCE(SUM(pnl), 0)::numeric(12,4) AS pnl_delta
  FROM btc.trades
  WHERE symbol = '$coin'
    AND dry_run = false
    AND profile = 'conservative'
    AND 'conservative' IN (${profile:sqlstring})
    AND (
      ('${servidor:raw}' = '.*' OR '${servidor:raw}' = '*' OR servidor = '${servidor:raw}')
    )
    AND timestamp BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo()
  GROUP BY 1
),
points AS (
  SELECT to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom()) AS "time", 0::numeric(12,4) AS pnl_delta, 0 AS sort_key
  UNION ALL SELECT "time", pnl_delta, 1 AS sort_key FROM bucketed
  UNION ALL SELECT to_timestamp($__unixEpochTo()) AS "time", 0::numeric(12,4) AS pnl_delta, 2 AS sort_key
)
SELECT "time",
  SUM(pnl_delta) OVER (ORDER BY "time", sort_key)::numeric(12,4) AS "Conservative PnL"
FROM points ORDER BY 1, sort_key

panels.description: TRS e boost por decisão (PostgreSQL). Histórico disponível desde o deploy da feature; intervalos anteriores ficam vazios. Stats acima usam snapshot Prometheus em tempo real.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  to_timestamp($__unixEpochGroup(bucket_epoch, $__interval)) AS "time",
  profile || ' TRS' AS metric,
  CASE WHEN sum(sample_count) > 0 THEN sum(avg_trs * sample_count) / sum(sample_count) ELSE NULL END AS value
FROM (
  SELECT
    extract(epoch from bucket_hour)::bigint AS bucket_epoch,
    profile,
    avg_trs,
    avg_boost,
    sample_count
  FROM btc.decisions_track_record_hourly
  WHERE symbol = '$coin'
    AND profile IN (${profile:sqlstring})
    AND (
      '${servidor:raw}' = '.*' OR '${servidor:raw}' = '*' OR servidor = '${servidor:raw}'
    )
    AND bucket_hour BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
) sub
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  to_timestamp($__unixEpochGroup(bucket_epoch, $__interval)) AS "time",
  profile || ' boost' AS metric,
  CASE WHEN sum(sample_count) > 0 THEN sum(avg_boost * sample_count) / sum(sample_count) ELSE NULL END AS value
FROM (
  SELECT
    extract(epoch from bucket_hour)::bigint AS bucket_epoch,
    profile,
    avg_trs,
    avg_boost,
    sample_count
  FROM btc.decisions_track_record_hourly
  WHERE symbol = '$coin'
    AND profile IN (${profile:sqlstring})
    AND (
      '${servidor:raw}' = '.*' OR '${servidor:raw}' = '*' OR servidor = '${servidor:raw}'
    )
    AND bucket_hour BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
) sub
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Distribuição acumulada de decisões BUY/SELL/HOLD no profile selecionado. Não é filtrada pela janela temporal do dashboard.
panels.title: 🎯 Distribuição de Decisões (Total)

targets.rawSql:
WITH api_trades AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      TO_TIMESTAMP(NULLIF(metadata->'fills'->0->>'createdAt', '')::double precision / 1000.0),
      TO_TIMESTAMP(timestamp),
      created_at
    ) AS exchange_time,
    side
  FROM btc.trades
  WHERE symbol = '$coin'
    AND order_id IS NOT NULL
    AND COALESCE(metadata->>'source', '') IN ('kucoin_live', 'kucoin_sync', 'kucoin_restore')
    AND profile ~* '^(${profile:pipe})$'
    AND (
      ('${servidor:raw}' = '.*' OR '${servidor:raw}' = '*' OR servidor = '${servidor:raw}')
    )
),
bucketed AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('hour', exchange_time) AS "time",
    CASE
      WHEN side = 'buy' THEN '🟢 Compras'
      WHEN side = 'sell' THEN '🔴 Vendas'
      ELSE side
    END AS metric,
    COUNT(*)::double precision AS value
  FROM api_trades
  WHERE exchange_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
series AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    date_trunc('hour', $__timeFrom()::timestamp),
    date_trunc('hour', $__timeTo()::timestamp),
    interval '1 hour'
  ) AS "time"
),
metrics AS (
  SELECT '🟢 Compras' AS metric
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '🔴 Vendas' AS metric
)
SELECT
  s."time",
  m.metric,
  COALESCE(b.value, 0)::double precision AS value
FROM series s
CROSS JOIN metrics m
LEFT JOIN bucketed b ON b."time" = s."time" AND b.metric = m.metric
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.description: Últimas decisões do agente de trading em tempo real (atualiza a cada 15s)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  TO_CHAR(to_timestamp("timestamp") AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'DD/MM HH24:MI') AS "Data/Hora",
  COALESCE(profile, 'default') AS profile,
  action,
  ROUND(confidence::numeric, 3) AS conf_adj,
  ROUND(NULLIF(features->>'raw_confidence', '')::numeric, 3) AS conf_raw,
  ROUND(NULLIF(features->>'track_record_boost', '')::numeric, 3) AS boost,
  ROUND(NULLIF(features->>'track_record_trs', '')::numeric, 3) AS trs,
  price,
  LEFT(reason, 80) AS reason,
  executed
FROM btc.decisions
WHERE symbol = '$coin'
AND profile ~* '^(${profile:pipe})$'
AND (
  ('${servidor:raw}' = '.*' OR '${servidor:raw}' = '*' OR servidor = '${servidor:raw}')
)
AND "timestamp" BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo()
ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.description: Somente trades confirmados pela API da KuCoin, usando o horario real do fill quando disponivel.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  TO_CHAR(
    COALESCE(
      TO_TIMESTAMP(NULLIF(metadata->'fills'->0->>'createdAt', '')::double precision / 1000.0),
      TO_TIMESTAMP(timestamp),
      created_at
    ) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo',
    'DD/MM HH24:MI'
  ) AS "Data/Hora",
  COALESCE(profile, 'default') AS "Profile",
  side AS "Side",
  ROUND(price::numeric, 2) AS "Preço",
  ROUND(size::numeric, 6) AS "Qtd BTC",
  ROUND(COALESCE(pnl, 0)::numeric, 4) AS "PnL ($)",
  ROUND(COALESCE(pnl_pct, 0)::numeric, 2) AS "PnL %",
  COALESCE(metadata->>'exit_reason', '') AS "Motivo"
FROM btc.trades
WHERE symbol = '$coin'
  AND order_id IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE(metadata->>'source', '') IN ('kucoin_live', 'kucoin_sync', 'kucoin_restore')
  AND profile ~* '^(${profile:pipe})$'
  AND (
    ('${servidor:raw}' = '.*' OR '${servidor:raw}' = '*' OR servidor = '${servidor:raw}')
  )
  AND COALESCE(
    TO_TIMESTAMP(NULLIF(metadata->'fills'->0->>'createdAt', '')::double precision / 1000.0),
    TO_TIMESTAMP(timestamp),
    created_at
  ) BETWEEN to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom()) AND to_timestamp($__unixEpochTo())
ORDER BY COALESCE(
    TO_TIMESTAMP(NULLIF(metadata->'fills'->0->>'createdAt', '')::double precision / 1000.0),
    TO_TIMESTAMP(timestamp),
    created_at
  ) DESC
LIMIT 100

panels.title: 📊 Trades Recentes

panels.description: Cada linha representa um trade como um bot independente. As colunas usam dados da propria linha; apenas Atual vem do mercado ao vivo para calcular falta, progresso e PnL.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest_profile_sell AS (
  SELECT
    profile,
    MAX(timestamp) AS last_sell_ts
  FROM btc.trades
  WHERE symbol = '$coin'
    AND dry_run = false
    AND side IN ('sell', 'sell_reconciled')
    AND profile IN ('aggressive', 'conservative', 'shadow')
    AND (
      ('${servidor:raw}' = '.*' OR '${servidor:raw}' = '*' OR servidor = '${servidor:raw}')
    )
  GROUP BY profile
),
open_buys_raw AS (
  SELECT
    t.*
  FROM btc.trades t
  LEFT JOIN latest_profile_sell lps ON lps.profile = t.profile
  WHERE t.symbol = '$coin'
    AND t.dry_run = false
    AND t.side = 'buy'
    AND t.status <> 'closed'
    AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'closed_reason', '') = ''
    AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'source', '') != 'external_deposit'
    AND t.profile IN ('aggressive', 'conservative', 'shadow')
    AND (
      ('${servidor:raw}' = '.*' OR '${servidor:raw}' = '*' OR servidor = '${servidor:raw}')
    )
    AND (lps.last_sell_ts IS NULL OR t.timestamp > lps.last_sell_ts)
),
position_summary AS (
  SELECT
    profile,
    CONCAT(
      profile,
      '#',
      MIN(id),
      CASE WHEN MIN(id) <> MAX(id) THEN CONCAT('-', MAX(id)) ELSE '' END
    ) AS position_ref,
    COUNT(*) AS entries
  FROM open_buys_raw
  WHERE profile ~* '^(${profile:pipe})$'
  GROUP BY profile
),
open_trades AS (
  SELECT
    ob.id,
    ob.profile,
    ob.price,
    ob.size,
    ps.position_ref,
    ps.entries,
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(ob.metadata->>'target_sell_trigger_price', '')::double precision,
      NULLIF(ob.metadata->>'target_sell_price', '')::double precision
    ) AS sell_target,
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(ob.metadata->>'target_sell_reason', ''),
      NULLIF(ob.metadata->>'strategy_reason', ''),
      NULLIF(ob.metadata->>'reason', '')
    ) AS target_reason
  FROM open_buys_raw ob
  JOIN position_summary ps ON ps.profile = ob.profile
  WHERE ob.profile ~* '^(${profile:pipe})$'
),
latest_state AS (
  SELECT
    price AS current_price
  FROM btc.market_states
  WHERE symbol = '$coin'
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  ot.id AS "Trade",
  ot.profile AS "Perfil",
  CONCAT(ot.profile, ' #', ot.id::text) AS "Bot",
  CASE
    WHEN ot.entries > 1 AND ot.target_reason IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('multientrada ', ot.entries, 'x • ', ot.target_reason)
    WHEN ot.entries > 1 THEN CONCAT('multientrada ', ot.entries, 'x em ', ot.position_ref)
    WHEN ot.target_reason IS NOT NULL THEN ot.target_reason
    ELSE CONCAT('entrada unica em ', ot.position_ref)
  END AS "Cenário",
  ROUND(ot.size::numeric, 8) AS "Qtd",
  ROUND(ot.price::numeric, 6) AS "Entrada",
  ROUND(ls.current_price::numeric, 6) AS "Atual",
  ROUND(ot.sell_target::numeric, 6) AS "Alvo",
  ROUND((ot.sell_target - ls.current_price)::numeric, 6) AS "Falta $",
  ROUND(((ot.sell_target / NULLIF(ls.current_price, 0) - 1) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS "Falta %",
  ROUND(
    LEAST(
      100,
      GREATEST(
        0,
        100 * (ls.current_price - ot.price) / NULLIF(ot.sell_target - ot.price, 0)
      )
    )::numeric,
    1
  ) AS "Progresso %",
  ROUND(((ls.current_price - ot.price) * ot.size)::numeric, 4) AS "PnL $",
  ROUND((((ls.current_price / NULLIF(ot.price, 0)) - 1) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS "PnL %",
  '🛒 Abrir menu' AS "Ação"
FROM open_trades ot
CROSS JOIN latest_state ls
ORDER BY ot.id DESC;

panels.description: Patrimônio em USDT por conta KuCoin (main, trade e subcontas sub:*, dinâmico) e por moeda (BTC convertido, USDT), com Total destacado. Fonte: btc.exchange_balance_snapshots (~15 min).

targets.rawSql:
WITH valid_snaps AS (
  -- ignora snapshots parciais (ex.: sync pós-venda rodado com credencial
  -- de subconta enxerga só 1 conta e derrubava o total do gráfico);
  -- escopado à janela de tempo: o GROUP BY da tabela inteira rodava
  -- 1x por linha da janela (nested loop) e derrubava o painel com 502
  SELECT synced_at
  FROM btc.exchange_balance_snapshots
  WHERE synced_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  GROUP BY synced_at
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT account_type) >= 3
      OR synced_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-07-03 21:00:00+00'
),
snap AS (
  SELECT s.synced_at, s.account_type, s.currency,
         s.balance * COALESCE(s.price_usdt, CASE WHEN s.currency = 'USDT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS usdt
  FROM btc.exchange_balance_snapshots s
  JOIN valid_snaps USING (synced_at)
)
SELECT synced_at AS time, 'Conta ' || account_type AS metric, SUM(usdt) AS value FROM snap GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT synced_at, 'Total', SUM(usdt) FROM snap GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL
SELECT synced_at, currency || ' (em USDT)', SUM(usdt) FROM snap WHERE currency <> 'USDT' GROUP BY 1, currency HAVING SUM(usdt) > 0.01
UNION ALL
SELECT synced_at, 'USDT', SUM(usdt) FROM snap WHERE currency = 'USDT' GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 📈 Evolução Patrimonial por Conta (USDT)

panels.description: Saldo total disponível na KuCoin convertido para BRL, somando as contas main e trade da conta master (subcontas não são sincronizadas). Taxa BRL do último snapshot.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest_sync AS (
  SELECT MAX(synced_at) AS synced_at
  FROM btc.exchange_balance_snapshots
), latest_balances AS (
  SELECT account_type, currency, available, price_usdt
  FROM btc.exchange_balance_snapshots ebs
  JOIN latest_sync ls ON ebs.synced_at = ls.synced_at
  WHERE ebs.available > 0
), brl_rate AS (
  SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN currency = 'BRL' THEN NULLIF(price_usdt, 0) END) AS brl_price_usdt
  FROM latest_balances
)
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(
  CASE
    WHEN lb.currency = 'BRL' THEN lb.available
    WHEN br.brl_price_usdt IS NULL OR br.brl_price_usdt = 0 THEN 0
    ELSE (lb.available * COALESCE(lb.price_usdt, CASE WHEN lb.currency = 'USDT' THEN 1 END, 0)) / br.brl_price_usdt
  END
), 0)::numeric, 2) AS value
FROM latest_balances lb
CROSS JOIN brl_rate br

panels.title: 🏦 Total Depositado (R$)

panels.description: Variação diária do patrimônio total em USDT: soma de todas as contas (main, trade e subcontas) do último snapshot de cada horário. Datas anteriores aos snapshots por conta usam a equity legada do master.

options.defaultContent: Sem dados em btc.exchange_snapshots para os últimos 90 dias.

targets.rawSql:
WITH balance_equity AS (
    SELECT
        synced_at AS ts,
        SUM(balance * COALESCE(price_usdt, CASE WHEN currency = 'USDT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS equity_usdt
    FROM btc.exchange_balance_snapshots
    WHERE $__timeFilter(synced_at)
      AND synced_at IN (
        SELECT synced_at FROM btc.exchange_balance_snapshots
        GROUP BY synced_at
        HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT account_type) >= 3
            OR MIN(synced_at) < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-07-03 21:00:00+00'
      )
    GROUP BY synced_at
),
legacy AS (
    -- equity antiga (exporter master) apenas para datas anteriores aos
    -- snapshots por conta; depois da migração para subcontas ela é parcial
    SELECT to_timestamp(timestamp) AS ts, equity_usdt
    FROM btc.exchange_snapshots
    WHERE timestamp BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo()
      AND to_timestamp(timestamp) < (SELECT COALESCE(MIN(synced_at), 'infinity'::timestamptz)
                                     FROM btc.exchange_balance_snapshots)
),
all_snapshots AS (
    SELECT * FROM balance_equity
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM legacy
),
daily AS (
    SELECT
        ts::date::text AS day,
        equity_usdt,
        FIRST_VALUE(equity_usdt) OVER w AS day_open,
        LAST_VALUE(equity_usdt)  OVER w AS day_close
    FROM all_snapshots
    WINDOW w AS (
        PARTITION BY ts::date
        ORDER BY ts
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
    )
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    day,
    ROUND(((day_close - day_open) / NULLIF(day_open, 0) * 100)::numeric, 3) AS pnl_pct,
    ROUND((day_close - day_open)::numeric, 2)                               AS pnl_usdt
FROM daily
ORDER BY day ASC

panels.description: Saldo BTC total nas sub-contas de trading (BTCAgressive + BTCConservative). Recompensas de mineração KuMining são creditadas nestas contas.

WITH latest AS (

  FROM btc.exchange_balance_snapshots
  WHERE currency = 'BTC'
    AND account_type IN ('sub:BTCAgressive', 'sub:BTCConservative')

WITH btc_snapshots AS (
  SELECT synced_at, SUM(balance) AS total_balance
  FROM btc.exchange_balance_snapshots
  WHERE currency = 'BTC'
    AND account_type IN ('sub:BTCAgressive', 'sub:BTCConservative')
  GROUP BY synced_at
),
period_ends AS (
  SELECT
    (ARRAY_AGG(total_balance ORDER BY synced_at DESC))[1] AS end_bal,
    (ARRAY_AGG(total_balance ORDER BY synced_at ASC))[1] AS start_bal
  FROM btc_snapshots
  WHERE synced_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
)
SELECT
  now() AS "time",
  COALESCE(end_bal - start_bal, 0) AS "Ganhos BTC"
FROM period_ends

targets.rawSql:
WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date AS month_start,
    (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date AS today
), scoped AS (
  SELECT
    e.*,
    (e.synced_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date AS dia,
    COALESCE(e.price_usdt, CASE WHEN e.currency = 'USDT' THEN 1.0 END) AS px
  FROM btc.exchange_balance_snapshots e
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE e.synced_at >= (p.month_start::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')
    AND e.synced_at < ((p.month_start + INTERVAL '1 month')::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')
    AND e.account_type IN ('trade','sub:BTCAgressive','sub:BTCConservative','sub:ETHAgressive','sub:ETHConservative')
    AND e.currency IN ('USDT','BTC','ETH','SOL','DOGE','BRL')
), latest_balances AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (account_type, currency)
    account_type, currency, synced_at, balance, available, holds, px
  FROM scoped
  WHERE px IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY account_type, currency, synced_at DESC
), current_accounts AS (
  SELECT
    account_type,
    max(synced_at) AS last_seen,
    round(sum(balance * px)::numeric, 2) AS value_usdt,
    string_agg(currency || ' ' || round(balance::numeric, 8)::text, ', ' ORDER BY currency) AS balances
  FROM latest_balances
  GROUP BY account_type
), current_rows AS (
  SELECT
    'account'::text AS kind,
    CASE WHEN account_type = 'TOTAL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS sort_group,
    account_type AS label,
    NULL::date AS dia,
    max(last_seen) AS last_seen,
    value_usdt,
    balances,
    NULL::numeric AS start_usdt,
    NULL::numeric AS end_usdt,
    NULL::numeric AS mtm_change_usdt,
    NULL::numeric AS mtm_pct,
    NULL::numeric AS realized_pnl_usdt,
    NULL::bigint AS buys,
    NULL::bigint AS sells,
    NULL::text AS note
  FROM (
    SELECT 'TOTAL'::text AS account_type, max(last_seen) AS last_seen, round(sum(value_usdt)::numeric, 2) AS value_usdt,
           string_agg(account_type || ' $' || value_usdt::text, '; ' ORDER BY account_type) AS balances
    FROM current_accounts
    UNION ALL
    SELECT account_type, last_seen, value_usdt, balances
    FROM current_accounts
  ) x
  GROUP BY account_type, value_usdt, balances
), first_rows AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (dia, account_type, currency)
    dia, account_type, currency, synced_at, balance, px
  FROM scoped
  WHERE px IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY dia, account_type, currency, synced_at ASC
), last_rows AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (dia, account_type, currency)
    dia, account_type, currency, synced_at, balance, px
  FROM scoped
  WHERE px IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY dia, account_type, currency, synced_at DESC
), daily_account AS (
  SELECT
    l.dia,
    l.account_type,
    sum(f.balance * f.px) AS start_usdt,
    sum(l.balance * l.px) AS end_usdt,
    min(f.synced_at) AS first_seen,
    max(l.synced_at) AS last_seen
  FROM last_rows l
  JOIN first_rows f USING (dia, account_type, currency)
  GROUP BY l.dia, l.account_type
), daily_total AS (
  SELECT
    dia,
    sum(start_usdt) AS start_usdt,
    sum(end_usdt) AS end_usdt,
    min(first_seen) AS first_seen,
    max(last_seen) AS last_seen
  FROM daily_account
  GROUP BY dia
), pnl AS (
  SELECT
    (to_timestamp(timestamp) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date AS dia,
    sum(CASE WHEN side = 'sell' THEN COALESCE(pnl, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS realized_pnl_usdt,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE side = 'buy') AS buys,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE side = 'sell') AS sells
  FROM btc.trades t
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE to_timestamp(t.timestamp) >= (p.month_start::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')
    AND to_timestamp(t.timestamp) < ((p.month_start + INTERVAL '1 month')::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')
    AND t.dry_run = false
    AND t.profile IN ('aggressive','conservative','shadow')
    AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'source','') NOT LIKE '%reconciliation%'
  GROUP BY 1
), last_slot AS (
  SELECT
    max(to_timestamp(timestamp)) AS closed_at,
    count(*) AS closed_count
  FROM btc.trades t
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE to_timestamp(t.timestamp) >= (p.month_start::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')
    AND t.dry_run = false
    AND t.side = 'sell'
    AND t.profile IN ('aggressive','conservative','shadow')
    AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'source','') NOT LIKE '%reconciliation%'
), daily_rows AS (
  SELECT
    'daily'::text AS kind,
    2 AS sort_group,
    to_char(dt.dia, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS label,
    dt.dia,
    dt.last_seen,
    NULL::numeric AS value_usdt,
    NULL::text AS balances,
    round(dt.start_usdt::numeric, 2) AS start_usdt,
    round(dt.end_usdt::numeric, 2) AS end_usdt,
    round((dt.end_usdt - dt.start_usdt)::numeric, 2) AS mtm_change_usdt,
    round((CASE WHEN dt.start_usdt <> 0 THEN (dt.end_usdt / dt.start_usdt - 1) * 100 END)::numeric, 3) AS mtm_pct,
    round(COALESCE(p.realized_pnl_usdt, 0)::numeric, 4) AS realized_pnl_usdt,
    COALESCE(p.buys, 0) AS buys,
    COALESCE(p.sells, 0) AS sells,
    CASE
      WHEN dt.dia = DATE '2026-07-03' THEN 'Subcontas entraram nos snapshots no meio do dia; MTM inclui redistribuicao entre contas.'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS note
  FROM daily_total dt
  LEFT JOIN pnl p USING (dia)
), meta_row AS (
  SELECT
    'meta'::text AS kind,
    -1 AS sort_group,
    'meta'::text AS label,
    NULL::date AS dia,
    greatest((SELECT max(last_seen) FROM current_accounts), (SELECT closed_at FROM last_slot)) AS last_seen,
    round((SELECT COALESCE(sum(realized_pnl_usdt), 0) FROM pnl)::numeric, 4) AS value_usdt,
    'Ultimo slot encerrado: ' || COALESCE(to_char((SELECT closed_at FROM last_slot) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), 'sem venda no mes')
      || ' | Vendas no mes: ' || COALESCE((SELECT closed_count FROM last_slot), 0)::text AS balances,
    NULL::numeric AS start_usdt,
    NULL::numeric AS end_usdt,
    NULL::numeric AS mtm_change_usdt,
    NULL::numeric AS mtm_pct,
    NULL::numeric AS realized_pnl_usdt,
    NULL::bigint AS buys,
    NULL::bigint AS sells,
    NULL::text AS note
)
SELECT * FROM meta_row
UNION ALL SELECT * FROM current_rows
UNION ALL SELECT * FROM daily_rows
ORDER BY sort_group, dia NULLS FIRST, label

targets.rawSql:
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(initial_capital), 100) FROM btc.profile_config WHERE profile ~* '^(${profile:pipe})$' AND true) AS initial_capital,
    count(*) AS total_trades,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE side='buy') AS buys,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE side='sell') AS sells,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE pnl > 0) AS wins,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE pnl < 0) AS losses,
    COALESCE(SUM(pnl), 0)::numeric(12,4) AS pnl_total,
    COALESCE(MAX(pnl), 0)::numeric(10,4) AS best_trade,
    COALESCE(MIN(pnl), 0)::numeric(10,4) AS worst_trade,
    to_timestamp(MIN(timestamp))::date AS first_trade_date
  FROM btc.trades
  WHERE symbol = '$coin'
  AND profile ~* '^(${profile:pipe})$' AND true
),
open_position AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(COALESCE(
    SUM(CASE
      WHEN side='buy' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'source','') != 'external_deposit' THEN size
      WHEN side='sell' THEN -size
      ELSE 0
    END), 0
  ), 0)::numeric(18,8) AS net_btc
  FROM btc.trades
  WHERE symbol = '$coin'
  AND profile ~* '^(${profile:pipe})$' AND true
),
price_now AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    (
      SELECT btc_price::numeric
      FROM btc.exchange_snapshots
      ORDER BY timestamp DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ),
    (
      SELECT price::numeric
      FROM btc.trades
      WHERE symbol = '$coin'
      AND profile ~* '^(${profile:pipe})$' AND true
      ORDER BY timestamp DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ),
    0
  )::numeric(10,2) AS btc_price
),
period_stats AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pnl), 0)::numeric(12,4) AS pnl_periodo, count(*) AS trades_periodo
  FROM btc.trades
  WHERE symbol = '$coin'
  AND profile ~* '^(${profile:pipe})$' AND true
  AND to_timestamp(timestamp) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
),
entry AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    (SUM(CASE WHEN side='buy' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'source','') != 'external_deposit' THEN funds ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN side='sell' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(funds,0), size*price) ELSE 0 END))
    / NULLIF((SUM(CASE WHEN side='buy' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'source','') != 'external_deposit' THEN size ELSE 0 END)
              - SUM(CASE WHEN side='sell' THEN size ELSE 0 END)), 0), 0
  )::numeric(10,2) AS avg_entry_raw
  FROM btc.trades
  WHERE symbol = '$coin'
  AND profile ~* '^(${profile:pipe})$' AND true
),
calc AS (
  SELECT
    s.initial_capital,
    s.total_trades, s.buys, s.sells, s.wins, s.losses,
    s.pnl_total, s.best_trade, s.worst_trade,
    COALESCE(TO_CHAR(s.first_trade_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), '--') AS primeiro_trade,
    COALESCE((NOW()::date - s.first_trade_date), 0) AS dias_operando,
    ROUND(CASE WHEN s.wins + s.losses > 0 THEN 100.0 * s.wins / (s.wins + s.losses) ELSE 0 END, 1) AS win_rate,
    op.net_btc AS position_btc,
    ROUND((op.net_btc * px.btc_price)::numeric, 2) AS position_usdt,
    ROUND(px.btc_price::numeric, 2) AS btc_price,
    CASE WHEN op.net_btc > 0 THEN e.avg_entry_raw ELSE NULL::numeric(10,2) END AS avg_entry,
    CASE WHEN op.net_btc > 0 THEN CONCAT('$ ', COALESCE(e.avg_entry_raw::text, '--')) ELSE '--' END AS avg_entry_display,
    ROUND(CASE WHEN op.net_btc > 0 AND e.avg_entry_raw IS NOT NULL THEN ((px.btc_price - e.avg_entry_raw) / NULLIF(e.avg_entry_raw, 0) * 100)::numeric ELSE 0 END, 2) AS entry_diff,
    CASE WHEN op.net_btc > 0 AND e.avg_entry_raw IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('Preco live: $ ', ROUND(px.btc_price::numeric, 2)::text, ' (', ROUND(((px.btc_price - e.avg_entry_raw) / NULLIF(e.avg_entry_raw, 0) * 100)::numeric, 2)::text, '%)') ELSE CONCAT('Sem posicao aberta • Preco live: $ ', ROUND(px.btc_price::numeric, 2)::text) END AS entry_context,
    ROUND((s.initial_capital + s.pnl_total + (op.net_btc * (px.btc_price - COALESCE(CASE WHEN op.net_btc > 0 THEN e.avg_entry_raw END, px.btc_price))))::numeric, 2) AS equity_total,
    ROUND((s.initial_capital + s.pnl_total - (op.net_btc * COALESCE(CASE WHEN op.net_btc > 0 THEN e.avg_entry_raw END, px.btc_price)))::numeric, 2) AS usdt_free,
    ROUND((((s.initial_capital + s.pnl_total + (op.net_btc * (px.btc_price - COALESCE(CASE WHEN op.net_btc > 0 THEN e.avg_entry_raw END, px.btc_price)))) - s.initial_capital) / NULLIF(s.initial_capital, 0) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS roi_pct,
    period_stats.pnl_periodo, period_stats.trades_periodo,
    10 AS n_entries
  FROM stats s
  CROSS JOIN open_position op
  CROSS JOIN price_now px
  CROSS JOIN period_stats
  CROSS JOIN entry e
)
SELECT
  c.*,
  CASE WHEN c.roi_pct >= 0 THEN '#73BF69' ELSE '#F2495C' END AS roi_color,
  CASE WHEN c.roi_pct >= 0 THEN '▲' ELSE '▼' END AS roi_arrow,
  CASE WHEN c.pnl_total >= 0 THEN '#73BF69' ELSE '#F2495C' END AS pnl_color,
  CASE WHEN c.pnl_periodo >= 0 THEN '#73BF69' ELSE '#F2495C' END AS pnl_periodo_color,
  CASE WHEN c.avg_entry IS NULL OR c.btc_price >= c.avg_entry THEN '#73BF69' ELSE '#F2495C' END AS entry_color,
  CASE WHEN c.roi_pct >= 0
    THEN 'linear-gradient(90deg, #73BF69, #56A64B)'
    ELSE 'linear-gradient(90deg, #F2495C, #CC3A4A)'
  END AS roi_gradient,
  LEAST(GREATEST(ABS(c.roi_pct), 1), 100) AS roi_bar_width
FROM calc c;

panels.description: Percentual de acerto do sentimento previsto pela IA por fonte de notícia. Método: se BULLISH e BTC subiu em 4h → acerto; se BEARISH e BTC caiu em 4h → acerto. Acerto < 50% indica sinal contrário (inverter previsão).

targets.rawSql:
WITH article_with_prices AS (
    SELECT
        ns.source,
        ns.sentiment,
        (SELECT m.price FROM btc.market_states m
         WHERE m.symbol = '$coin'
           AND m.timestamp BETWEEN EXTRACT(epoch FROM ns.timestamp) - 300
                               AND EXTRACT(epoch FROM ns.timestamp) + 300
         ORDER BY ABS(m.timestamp - EXTRACT(epoch FROM ns.timestamp))
         LIMIT 1) AS price_at,
        (SELECT m.price FROM btc.market_states m
         WHERE m.symbol = '$coin'
           AND m.timestamp BETWEEN EXTRACT(epoch FROM ns.timestamp) + 13950
                               AND EXTRACT(epoch FROM ns.timestamp) + 14850
         ORDER BY ABS(m.timestamp - (EXTRACT(epoch FROM ns.timestamp) + 14400))
         LIMIT 1) AS price_4h
    FROM btc.news_sentiment ns
    WHERE ns.coin = SPLIT_PART('$coin', '-', 1)
      AND ns.sentiment != 0
      AND NOT (ns.sentiment = 0 AND ns.confidence = 0.25)
      AND ns.timestamp < NOW() - INTERVAL '4 hours'
),
acertos AS (
    SELECT
        source,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE price_at IS NOT NULL AND price_4h IS NOT NULL) AS previsoes,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE price_at IS NOT NULL AND price_4h IS NOT NULL
            AND ((sentiment > 0.1 AND price_4h > price_at)
              OR (sentiment < -0.1 AND price_4h < price_at))) AS acertos
    FROM article_with_prices
    GROUP BY source
)
SELECT
    INITCAP(source)           AS "Fonte",
    previsoes                 AS "Previsões",
    acertos                   AS "Acertos",
    ROUND(100.0 * acertos / NULLIF(previsoes, 0), 1) AS "% Acerto",
    CASE
        WHEN previsoes < 5 THEN '⏳ Amostra curta'
        WHEN ROUND(100.0 * acertos / NULLIF(previsoes, 0), 1) >= 50 THEN '✅ Positivo'
        WHEN ROUND(100.0 * acertos / NULLIF(previsoes, 0), 1) >= 40 THEN '⚠️ Fraco'
        ELSE '🔄 Contrário'
    END                       AS "Sinal"
FROM acertos
WHERE previsoes >= 1
ORDER BY ROUND(100.0 * acertos / NULLIF(previsoes, 0), 1) DESC, previsoes DESC
